decision.conclusion: All sustained near-capacity samples completed with the receipt clock enabled. Bounded adaptive polling materially reduced poll count and did not regress the reported receipt quantiles in this host run. It remains experimental because collector CPU, paired confidence intervals, and the predeclared readiness-policy acceptance calculation were not collected by this matrix.

limitations: Receipt histograms use power-of-two upper bounds rather than exact quantiles.
This is an adaptive-polling comparison, not the required readiness-driven collector policy decision.
No process-level collector CPU measurement or paired confidence interval was retained, so this evidence cannot promote a policy default.
